title: FilterGraph
description: An FFmpeg filtergraph consisting of one or more filter chains.

chains.description: The filter chains that make up the filtergraph. Chains are separated by ';' in the FFmpeg filtergraph string.

sws_flags.description: Global scaling flags passed to libswscale (e.g. 'lanczos', 'bicubic'). Prepended as 'sws_flags=<value>;' in the filtergraph string.

FilterChain.description: A linear sequence of filters. Adjacent filters are connected implicitly; filters are separated by ',' in the FFmpeg filtergraph string.

Filter.description: A single FFmpeg filter with optional input/output stream labels and arguments.

input_labels.description: Stream labels consumed by this filter (e.g. '[main]', '[0:v]'). Rendered as '[label]' before the filter name.

instance.description: Optional instance identifier appended as '@<instance>' to distinguish multiple uses of the same filter.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the filter, rendered in order and joined with ':'. An object holds named arguments alone (KVArgs), an array holds arguments in the order they render (OrderedArgs), and a string is a pre-formed argument string (RawArgs). Null means no arguments, the same as omitting the member.

output_labels.description: Stream labels produced by this filter. Rendered as '[label]' after the filter and its arguments.

KVArgs.description: Named filter arguments. Each entry is serialized as 'key=value' and joined with ':'. An empty string value renders as 'key=' and sets the option to the empty string; FFmpeg has no bare-flag form for filter arguments, so a key never renders alone. A key may hold none of "[]=;,:'\\" or whitespace: FFmpeg reads an option name with no escaping of its own, so such a key cannot be delivered. Values are unrestricted. Arguments repeating a key take the OrderedArgs form, since an object cannot hold one twice.

OrderedArgs.description: Filter arguments in the order they render, joined with ':'. A string is positional, filling the filter's next declared option, and an object contributes its named arguments in place. FFmpeg fills options positionally only up to the first 'key=value', so every string must precede every object. An array of strings alone is the all-positional form used by filters like 'format'. This is also the form arguments take when a key repeats, one one-key object per argument, which FFmpeg resolves by taking the last.

RawArgs.description: A pre-formed argument string, rendered exactly as given, with the caller owning the escaping. Arguments carrying any raw part are written in this form rather than as the parts they were built from.

Label.description: A stream label used to connect filters across chains. May also be an FFmpeg input stream specifier such as '0:v' or '1:a'.
